annotations.title: Sentiment analysis API: positive or negative with a confidence score

description: Sentiment analysis of text: positive or negative with a confidence score, from a DistilBERT model fine-tuned on SST-2, for English text. Use to classify reviews, support tickets, social posts, headlines and replies at scale, or as the scoring step of a monitoring agent. Example: text=The checkout was fast and support answered within minutes.. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: ai_sentiment_analysis
